flags.issue: UNDECIDABLE: The paper is an observational study of human developers using agents. One participant (P13) used 'linter feedback' to review code manually. It is unclear if this manual use of a linter qualifies as a tool validating code 'within the paper's system or process'.

TESTS: manual testing and automated test cases; AUTHOR: mixed — P6 had agents generate test cases for every agentic change, S31 had AI sketch tests for humans to refine, and others manually tested code.
